subject: Polaris Bank CAIQ: delivery checklist and audit notes
messages:
From: Alice McLean <alice.mclean@polarisbank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Polaris CAIQ — control clarifications and evidence scope request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Polaris' audit team is preparing our CAIQ (CSA) intake and we filed a short list of clarifications that came up during the review. We need a consolidated mapping to CSA control IDs and a deliverable that covers the following by EOD Tue 13 Jan:

- Updated CAIQ control matrix with column for "evidence artifact name" and "owner" (we need owners for any runtime logs).
- Runtime log samples for control PR.AU-6 and PR.DS-3 (redacted acceptable; auditors want timestamped request/response traces).
- Key rotation policy artifacts for KMS usage and HSM attestations (or vendor statement).
- A short note on multi-tenancy isolation: which CAIQ sub-controls are covered by our tenant routing / namespace design.

Can you confirm you can deliver a bundle and provide secure, time-limited access to the raw logs for auditors? If an NDA or scoped access agreement is required, flag it in your response.

Appreciate quick confirmation — auditors are on a tight window.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice McLean
Director, Security Assurance
Polaris Bank

(attachment: polaris_caiq_questions_v1.pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice McLean <alice.mclean@polarisbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Polaris CAIQ — control clarifications and evidence scope request

Hi Alice — thanks for the note. We can meet the Tue 13 Jan EOD target. High-level plan:

1) Deliverables (by Tue 13 Jan):
   - caiq_control_matrix_v2.xlsx (mapping + evidence column + owner) — owner: Kimberly Park
   - log_sample_redacted.tar.gz — owner: Marissa Cole (CS ops)
   - deployment-diagram.png and tenant-isolation-notes.docx — owner: Jonas Weber
   - evidence-delivery-checklist.docx (delivery steps and access window) — owner: Naomi Feldman

2) Audit access: we'll provide a secure folder link (Google Drive with enforced link expiration) and a separate time-limited SFTP endpoint for raw log pulls. We will require a scoped auditor access agreement. Can Polaris send the auditor list and preferred access window?

3) Redaction approach: we'll remove personal data fields and mask IPs; include a short sampling statement for chain-of-custody.

I'll attach the draft matrix now (v2) and start the log extraction; Kimberly will follow up on artifact selection.

-Jonas

(attachments: caiq_control_matrix_v2.xlsx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Polaris CAIQ artifacts — selection and redaction notes

Folks — quick internal sync before we send the bundle:

- I reviewed Alice's list and annotated the matrix with where CAIQ sub-controls map to our policies. Key asks: PR.AU-6 (audit logs) and PR.DS-3 (data in transit protection).
- For PR.AU-6 we will provide: event logs (auth success/failure), token issuance traces (time, client_id), and a 30-minute conversation-level trace showing KV cache behavior. Redact user_identifiers per our PII policy.
- For PR.DS-3 include TLS config screenshots and link to our cipher suite policy.
- KMS rotation: provide KMS policy excerpt + vendor HSM attestation (if vendor provides). If not, provide operational rotation logs and key lifecycle checklist.

Marissa — can you package the log sample into the tar.gz and include a README that describes the sampling window and redaction regex? Use the internal evidence-delivery-checklist template.

I'll run a fast review on Tue morning and sign off. If anything slips, Jonas please escalate.

-Kim
Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference

(attachment: internal_caiq_notes.txt)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice McLean <alice.mclean@polarisbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 11:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Polaris CAIQ — v2 evidence bundle and access plan

Alice — attaching the deliverables per our plan. The drive folder below contains the redacted log sample and the control matrix with owners populated. We included a short-lived SFTP endpoint for auditors; credentials and expiration details are in the evidence-delivery-checklist.docx.

Delivery summary:
- caiq_control_matrix_v2.xlsx (owners + evidence artifact names)
- log_sample_redacted.tar.gz (README included; sampling window 2026-01-06 08:00 to 2026-01-06 10:00 PST)
- deployment-diagram.png (tenant namespace call-outs)
- evidence-delivery-checklist.docx (access steps, contact points, and escalation path)

Secure links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPolarisCAIQShare (expires 2026-01-20)
- SFTP: sftp.redwood-secure.com (temporary acct: polaris_audit_2026, expires 2026-01-18)

Notes and exceptions:
- Raw logs are redacted for user identifiers and IP addresses; we can provide time-limited unredacted access only to named auditors after a signed access agreement.
- HSM attestation is vendor-provided; included as a vendor statement, not raw HSM logs.

If the auditors need direct timeline walkthroughs, we can schedule a 30-minute session to walk through the log README and sampling choices — suggest Wed 14 Jan 09:00-12:00 PST.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Trust & Security Programs
Redwood Inference

(attachments: caiq_control_matrix_v2.xlsx; log_sample_redacted.tar.gz; deployment-diagram.png; evidence-delivery-checklist.docx)

From: Alice McLean <alice.mclean@polarisbank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Polaris Security Team <security@polarisbank.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Polaris CAIQ — v2 evidence bundle and access plan

Jonas — received. Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear checklist.

A couple of quick items before we hand to auditors:
- We need time-limited access for two named auditors (I will send names now). Please advise if you require an NDA first or if the scoped access agreement in your checklist suffices.
- Can you expose a sample of the unredacted token issuance trace for internal QA (not for external audit) so our engineering reviewer can validate the sampling approach? A 2-hour window tomorrow would do.

If you can confirm those, we will proceed with the auditor list and schedule.

Best,
Alice
Director, Security Assurance
Polaris Bank

(attachment: polaris_audit_list.csv)
